exposure: World Health Organization's Caregiver Skills Training Programme (WHO CST) delivered via eLearning (EL)
World Health Organization's Caregiver Skills Training Programme (WHO CST) delivered via videoconferencing (VC)
World Health Organization's Caregiver Skills Training Programme (WHO CST) delivered via in-person hybrid (IP)
outcome: Child's challenging behaviors (Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire - SDQ Difficulties-total)
Child's prosocial behavior (Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire - SDQ Prosocial Scale)
cohort: The study included 34 parent-child dyads in Hong Kong where children had developmental disabilities.
finding: The WHO Caregiver Skills Training Programme delivered through eLearning, videoconferencing, and in-person hybrid modalities was found to be acceptable and feasible, demonstrating positive impacts on both caregivers' well-being and children's communication and behaviors.
